chunks: Still they say: 'O Lord, give us our share before the Day of Reeking.'
ai.seo_question: What did the disbelievers ask God to hasten on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse captures the impatience of the disbelievers who, facing the reality of accountability, wish to expedite their portion of reward or punishment to avoid the prolonged anxiety of the final reckoning. It underscores the psychological state of those who reject divine timing, preferring immediate resolution over the certainty of the Hereafter.
